item.title: Cartoon of the Week: Apparently, it’s 6–7 now
item.description: Online trends sneak into political conversations. Because apparently what’s trending can matter more than, you know… actual answers. When a meme goes viral, it can suddenly feel like the main issue—whether it makes sense or not. Which is fitting, since “6–7” itself barely means anything at all.
